description: Construction-time validator (Go `ValidateTopic`, Rust `validate_topic`): 4 non-empty segments of [a-z0-9_] (a leading digit or underscore is allowed), no length cap, and a past-tense action (ends in 'ed' or in the whitelist). `error` is the exact error text, or `error_contains` lists substrings the text must contain when the tail names a language-specific identifier (see README); positions are 0-based. Checks run in order: empty, segment count, segments left to right, tense.

cases.error: topic is empty (expected source.category.object.action)

cases.name: 'a.b.c'
cases.error: topic "a.b.c" has 3 segments; expected 4 (source.category.object.action)

cases.name: 'a.b.c.d.e'
cases.error: topic "a.b.c.d.e" has 5 segments; expected 4 (source.category.object.action)

cases.name: 'a..c.created'
cases.error: topic "a..c.created" has empty segment at position 1

cases.name: 'a.b.c.'
cases.error: topic "a.b.c." has empty segment at position 3

cases.name: '.b.c.created'
cases.error: topic ".b.c.created" has empty segment at position 0

cases.name: 'A.b.c.created'
cases.error: topic "A.b.c.created" segment "A" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores

cases.name: 'a.*.c.created'
cases.error: topic "a.*.c.created" segment "*" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores

cases.name: 'a.b.c.#'
cases.error: topic "a.b.c.#" segment "#" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores

cases.name: 'a-b.c.d.created'
cases.error: topic "a-b.c.d.created" segment "a-b" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores

cases.name: 'é.b.c.created'
cases.error: topic "é.b.c.created" segment "é" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores

cases.name: 'a.b.c.create'
error_contains: topic "a.b.c.create" action segment "create" is not past-tense (e.g. "started", "created")

cases.name: 'a.b.c.run'
error_contains: topic "a.b.c.run" action segment "run" is not past-tense (e.g. "started", "created")

cases.name: 'a.b.c.d'
error_contains: topic "a.b.c.d" action segment "d" is not past-tense (e.g. "started", "created")

cases.name: 'a.b.c.starting'
error_contains: topic "a.b.c.starting" action segment "starting" is not past-tense (e.g. "started", "created")

cases.name: 'a.b.c.Created'
cases.error: topic "a.b.c.Created" segment "Created" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores
